status: Provisional section scenarios, not surveyed culvert geometry or a structural/hydraulic design.
routePolicy: Use the existing 45 m crossing chord; it is a search corridor, not a verified barrel alignment.
inletReference: Continue the assumed rendered eastern drain bed to the crossing entrance; the intervening unrendered reach has no surveyed invert.
coverPolicy: Modelling allowance above roof, not a historical specification or structural adequacy check.
sectionShape: rectangular equivalent opening; masonry shape, material and number of barrels unknown

railwayHeightReview.interpretation: Map shows the road crossing over the railway. Linear interpolation between road bridge spots is a provisional deck profile. The inherited constant railway formation exceeds this deck estimate even before adding rails or requiring clearance. It must not be used as a calibrated flood barrier.
railwayHeightReview.action: Review the longitudinal railway profile and road bridge together; the bridge gives a local constraint, not a measured track height at the drainage crossing.

limitations: Western outfall and channel bed remain unresolved.
Positive bed gradient does not prove water will flow: upstream and downstream water levels and gate operation are still required.
No discharge or capacity inferred from opening area.
The deeper case requires a revised approach channel; not connected automatically to the existing rendered bed.
Cases apply only to the 1900 reconstruction; other years require period review.
